text: arya: Quick copy pass request — we're consolidating the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages into a single product flow and need a final sweep on hero, microcopy, and CTAs. Can everyone scan the draft below? michael: Sending in 5. Focus areas: clarity for self-serve vs enterprise, routing for inbound leads, and a succinct benchmark line. jess: Nice. Also flagging webinar CTA placement — we want it on both hero and pricing anchor. arya: Draft hero options (very short): - Option A: "Fast, predictable LLM inference — hosted, reserved, or private" - Option B: "Serve LLMs at production scale: Hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private deployments" - Option C: "Same API. Any environment. Predictable performance." sam: I like Option C for developer-first vibe, but maybe add a benefit: "Same API. Any environment. Predictable performance and cost." jess: OK happy path: C + benefit. For enterprise headline we could add a 2nd-line: "SLA-backed dedicated capacity and private deployments for regulated workloads." Keep short. arya: Microcopy suggestions for hero CTAs: - Primary (self-serve): "Get started — free credits" - Secondary (enterprise): "Talk to sales — SLA & private deployment" - Tertiary (resources): "See benchmarks & webinar" michael: For inbound routing: we should use hidden form fields to capture "intended_deployment" with values: hosted, dedicated, private. Then route: hosted -> marketing SDR; dedicated/private -> AE. Add UTM tag suggestion: utm_campaign=pages-launch-2026. jess: Example form snippet for routing (short): ```html ``` Use simple radios earlier so users choose. sam: Benchmarks microcopy idea: one short sentence + CTA to deep dive: "1–2× lower tail latency at scale vs unmanaged endpoints. See benchmarks." But keep wording non-absolute: "up to 2× lower tail latency". arya: Webinar placement: hero tertiary CTA should open a lightweight modal with two options: watch recording or sign up for live. Add a note in modal: "Live seats limited — enterprise priority access." michael: Can we add an explicit section on "Which plan is right for you" (3 bullets)? suggested copy: - Hosted: "Instant API access, pay-as-you-go, best for prototypes and products that need fast time-to-value." - Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput, ideal for steady high-volume apps." - Private: "VPC/on-prem for regulated data and air-gapped environments." jess: CTA phrasing across pages should be consistent: primary for devs always "Get started — free credits"; enterprise route always "Contact sales". Mobile needs the primary sticky CTA. sam: A/B test plan quick notes: - Variant A: Option C hero line + 3 CTAs as above. - Variant B: Option B hero line with a short benchmark line under it. - Metrics: click-through on primary CTA, enterprise contact submissions, webinar signups. Run 7–14 days. arya: Tiny copy edits for SEO/meta: include keywords "LLM inference", "low-latency inference", "dedicated GPU serving" in headings and H1 alt. Keep human-first. michael: I trimmed the long draft and pushed to the staging page (link: https://staging.redwood.ai/pages/unified). Please review microcopy in place. jess: Reviewing now. Noting a weird comma in the Dedicated bullet. Also propose replacing "air-gapped" with "air-gapped or on-prem" for clarity. arya: Final ask: can each of you drop 1 sentence edits in this thread by EOD so I can hand off to engineering for the form routing? :sparkles: sam: Will do — dropping mine in 20. michael: Done — I updated the modal copy to: "Live seats limited — priority access for enterprise customers." jess: Done — replaced comma, and changed air-gapped line. Also added mobile sticky CTA note. marketing-bot: Reminder: sprint content freeze in 48 hours. arya: Great, thanks everyone. I'll consolidate and send final copy to eng for the routing hidden field + UTM. :rocket:
